test.name: Source-vs-source disagreement is handed back to conflict-resolution
test.description: The delegation describes two sources giving mutually exclusive values for the same fact (County Kerry vs County Cork — two Irish counties at the same administrative level, not a container/contained pair). That is a source conflict, not a single-person impossibility, so it belongs to conflict-resolution. Under the lead's 2026-09-23 ruling an agent never spawns another agent: the agent makes no tool call and hands the request back, naming conflict-resolution in its caller-facing lines (before the final `---`) and never in the researcher-facing paragraphs after it. grade_on_invariant: true hands the verdict to the tag-gated validator (test_conflict_resolution_hand_back); the judge is diagnostic. See unit-test-spec.md § 'Negative tests' and issue #2118.

input.delegation:
One census says he was born in County Kerry, the death cert says County Cork -- flag that mismatch.

negative.explanation: A source-vs-source disagreement is a conflict, not a warning. Warnings are about a single person's data violating physical/biological/temporal constraints; conflicts are about two sources giving different answers for the same fact. County Kerry and County Cork are two distinct Irish counties at the same administrative level — not a container/contained pair — so they are genuinely mutually exclusive values. Appendix B of the agent body draws this boundary explicitly: 'Conflicts: two or more sources disagree about the same fact for the same person... handled by conflict-resolution.' The agent body requires a hand-back: no tool call, and one caller-facing `Hand-back: conflict-resolution` line.

judge_context: Should NOT invoke person_warnings -- the request is not about a single-person impossibility
Should hand the request back: no tool call, no analysis of the discrepancy, and a caller-facing line naming conflict-resolution before the final `---`
The two researcher-facing paragraphs after the final `---` must name no skill, agent, tool or field
